learnings: Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security concerns' and 'inconclusive due to tool failures' in verdict reporting
When a model has coverage gaps from API errors, weight the complete analysis from another model more heavily
Implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur to prevent incomplete audits
The audit tool should flag tool failures separately from security findings to avoid conflating coverage issues with safety concerns
